newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Demerger seen helping Brit.Gas.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Demerger seen helping Brit.Gas.

text.p: The planned split of British Gas Plc into two will help the trouble-hit company by allowing two sets of management to concentrate on their own problems, British Gas chairman Richard Giordano said on Thursday.

"British Gas has a whole range of problems -- the problems (after demerger) will be addressed by separate management teams who are not involved in each other's problems," Giordano told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Giordano described the move as "a historic event" as the company, privatised in 1986, detailed plans for the demerger early next year.
